A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LogicReward research despite the changed title. All 22 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–H, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-training and evaluation results in Tables 1–2, analyses in Figures 4–6, and training-paradigm and data-selection experiments in Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark evaluations, ablations, faithfulness assessments, and Appendix F experiments.

M1.justification: Premise Validity, Logic Validity, soft unification, prover-guided refinement, and the SFT/DPO training procedure are unchanged. Appendix G retains the same three algorithms despite pagination changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight NLI/logical-reasoning datasets and the same BBH, GSM8K, and CommonsenseQA evaluations. Section 3.1 now explicitly names datasets already identified in v1's Appendix C.1; coverage does not expand.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and Figures 4–7, including the model baselines, Confidence, LLM-as-judge, PRM, outcome-only supervision, and alternative training paradigms.

E3.justification: Both retain the same sampling rules, exact-match metric, decoding temperatures, model sizes, and training settings. The 300-question main evaluations, 500-instance OOD samples, and Appendix E training schedules are unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 5.1–5.5 retain the same component ablations, faithfulness assessment, OOD and label-free evaluations, and soft-unification/refinement analyses. Appendix F retains the same training-paradigm and preference-pair selection analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version provides repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results and reported findings match throughout, including Table 1's LogicReward averages of 85.5 and 71.4 and Appendix F's pairing-strategy accuracies of 71.43, 67.67, and 67.03.

T1.justification: The validity definitions and reward equations in Section 3.2, including Equations 1–4, and the baseline reward formulas in Appendix D.2 are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The claims about benchmark performance, faithfulness, generalization, and learning without ground-truth labels remain unchanged. The revised title and contribution wording emphasize step-level supervision already central to v1, without changing the contribution's scope.

C2.justification: The explanations of performance and refinement effects are retained. Section 6 preserves the same limitations concerning imperfect autoformalization and the computational cost of theorem-prover-based labeling.

D1.justification: The abstract changes a promise to release code and data into a statement that they are available at the existing project URL. This updates reported access status, although Appendix C still promises release upon acceptance. Implementation details, hyperparameters, algorithms, and prompts are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. Section 3.1 associates explicit dataset names with citations already present in v1.

P1.justification: The paper is retitled 'LogicReward: Incentivizing LLM Reasoning via Step-Wise Logical Supervision.' v2 also changes the publication header, adds author email footnotes, explicitly names datasets in Section 3.1, and makes small wording edits. The section structure and most prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–3 retain their content and design. Front-matter edits cause limited reflow, while appendix spacing changes move Algorithm 1 from page 21 to pages 20–21 and alter the prompt box's page break.

improvement.justification: The method, empirical evidence, analyses, and limitations remain unchanged. Explicit dataset names provide a small readability benefit, but the updated availability statement uses an existing URL and conflicts with Appendix C's future-release wording. Together with limited layout changes, including splitting Algorithm 1 across pages, these edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
